about: Machine-readable comparison data for home backup power equipment. Compiled from manufacturer specifications and retailer listings. Prices are approximate US street prices and change often; verify before purchase.

expansion_batteries.name: EcoFlow DELTA Pro Smart Extra Battery
expansion_batteries.notes: LFP add-on battery for the original DELTA Pro only; one pack doubles it to 7.2kWh, two reach 10.8kWh; 3,500 cycles to 80%. EcoFlow US collection page states this battery will not be restocked (Nov 2026 check).

expansion_batteries.compatible: BLUETTI Apex 300, AC300, AC500, AC200L, AC200MAX
expansion_batteries.name: BLUETTI B300K Expansion Battery
expansion_batteries.notes: LiFePO4 pack with 4,000+ cycles to 80%; also has a small USB output for standalone use.

expansion_batteries.name: Jackery Battery Pack 2000 Plus
expansion_batteries.notes: LiFePO4 pack for the Explorer 2000 Plus only; up to five packs per station (12kWh), or 24kWh across paired stations. Listed at $799 on Jackery US (Nov 2026 check); shown sold out there at check time. 2026-11-13 check: back in stock at Jackery US at $799 (was sold out).

installed_cost_ranges_usd.note: Includes equipment, transfer switch, typical gas and electrical work, permits, and pad. Complex installs run higher.

portable_generators.name: Honda EU2200i
portable_generators.notes: The benchmark small inverter: GXR120 commercial engine, recoil start only, parallel-capable; 3.2-8.1 hrs on a 0.95-gal tank.

portable_generators.name: WEN 56235i
portable_generators.notes: Budget Honda alternative; fuel shutoff drains the carb for storage; 2-year warranty; about 10.5 hrs at quarter load. Price re-verified 2026-11-12: $509.99 at WEN's own store (wenproducts.com).

portable_generators.name: Westinghouse iGen4500
portable_generators.notes: Quietest in its size class; remote/electric/recoil start, RV TT-30R outlet, up to 18 hrs on 3.4 gal at quarter load. Nov 2026 check: delisted at Westinghouse's own store; superseded by the iGen5000 ($1,099 list). Norwall lists $1,029 out of stock. $899 kept as last price.

portable_generators.name: Champion 4500W Dual Fuel Inverter (200989)
portable_generators.notes: Dual fuel: 3,500 running watts on gasoline, 3,150 on propane; up to 14 hrs on gas, 21 hrs on propane; CO Shield shutoff. Champion US no longer lists this model (Nov 2026 check); successor 201319 listed at $1,022.99. Still sold at Norwall $786 (checked 2026-11-17).

portable_generators.name: Firman P03631
portable_generators.notes: Conventional open-frame 120/240V unit with remote start and 5-gal tank (14 hrs at 50% load); louder and dirtier power than inverters.

portable_generators.name: DuroMax XP13000EH
portable_generators.notes: Standby-class output in a portable frame: 10,500 running watts on gasoline, 10,000 on propane; 50A outlet for a transfer switch or inlet box.

portable_power_stations.name: EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra
portable_power_stations.notes: Whole-home capable with Smart Home Panel; stackable to 90kWh. 2026-11-13 check: base unit sold out at EcoFlow US (bundle variants $4,799-$8,599); price $4,199 unchanged.

portable_power_stations.name: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3
portable_power_stations.notes: 240V output; popular RV and home backup pick.

portable_power_stations.name: EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max
portable_power_stations.notes: Mid-size essentials backup; LFP battery. 2026-11-15 check: base unit $1,029 in stock at EcoFlow US (compare-at $1,299); $1,049 was a members-only bundle variant.

portable_power_stations.name: BLUETTI AC300 + B300K
portable_power_stations.notes: Modular system; good value per watt-hour. AC300 kits no longer listed on BLUETTI US at Nov 2026 check; Apex 300 is the current replacement line.

portable_power_stations.name: BLUETTI Apex 300
portable_power_stations.notes: Modular home-backup station; expandable up to 58kWh with B300K batteries; 120/240V output.

portable_power_stations.name: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2
portable_power_stations.notes: Sealed 2kWh-class station; 3,900W Power Lifting mode for resistive loads.

portable_power_stations.name: Jackery Explorer 2000 Plus
portable_power_stations.notes: Expandable to 24kWh; strong solar-charging ecosystem. Discontinued per Jackery US (Nov 2026 check); successor is the HomePower 2000 Plus v2.

portable_power_stations.name: Jackery Explorer 1000 v2
portable_power_stations.notes: Light essentials and camping; fast AC charging. Sold out on Jackery US at Nov 2026 check (Dune White $509, Black $559). 2026-11-13 check: Dune White $589 at Jackery US (was $509); Black $559; all variants sold out.

portable_power_stations.name: Jackery Explorer 300 Plus
portable_power_stations.notes: Backpack-size LiFePO4 station; discontinued in the US in 2026, price is last US list price. Discontinued per Jackery CA/UK pages (Nov 2026 check); successor is the Explorer 300 v2.

sizing_rule_of_thumb.mid_size_home_2000_sqft_kw: 14-18 for essentials-plus, 20-24 for whole-home with load management
sizing_rule_of_thumb.note: Actual sizing depends on HVAC tonnage, well pump, electric range/dryer, and load management. Starting (surge) watts of central AC are the usual deciding factor.

solar_panels.name: EcoFlow 400W Rigid Solar Panel
solar_panels.notes: Rigid monocrystalline panel, 23% efficiency, IP68; sold per panel, usually in 2-packs (~$999). For permanent mounts feeding EcoFlow stations or a home system.

solar_panels.name: EcoFlow 220W Bifacial Portable Solar Panel
solar_panels.notes: Folding bifacial panel: 220W front plus a 155W rear face for ambient/reflected light; IP68; the carry-anywhere pick for EcoFlow stations. Now sold as the NextGen 220W Bifacial panel.

solar_panels.name: Jackery SolarSaga 200W Solar Panel
solar_panels.notes: Folding panel with Jackery DC8020 connector for Explorer stations; IP68; USB-A/USB-C ports on the panel itself.

solar_panels.name: BLUETTI PV350 Solar Panel
solar_panels.notes: Big folding panel for fast charging of larger BLUETTI stations; MC4 output also works with most other brands' MPPT inputs.

standby_generators.name: Generac Guardian 26kW
standby_generators.notes: Largest air-cooled Guardian; 22.5kW on natural gas; Wi-Fi monitoring standard. 2026-11-12 check: Norwall lists $6,849 in stock (price left at $6,900, within 2%); Norwall's og:availability meta reads 'oos' — stale tag, watch.

standby_generators.name: Generac Guardian 24kW
standby_generators.notes: Best-selling whole-home standby in the US; large dealer network. Now the Next Gen model 7326: 24kW LP / 22.5kW NG, 200-amp transfer switch with whole-home surge protection included, cellular + Wi-Fi monitoring. Replaced the discontinued 7209 on 2026-11-13; price at Norwall.

standby_generators.name: Generac Guardian 22kW
standby_generators.notes: Whole-home coverage for mid-to-large homes; 19.5kW on natural gas.

fuel_consumption.source: Generac Guardian 10/14/18 kW spec sheet (model G007226)

standby_generators.name: Generac Guardian 18kW
standby_generators.notes: Common pick for essentials-plus coverage in mid-size homes.

standby_generators.notes: Largest air-cooled Kohler; 24kW on natural gas; 39 kVA motor-starting capacity.

standby_generators.notes: Known for fast (10-second) transfer and corrosion-resistant enclosure.

standby_generators.name: Cummins QuietConnect 20kW (RS20A)
standby_generators.notes: Among the quietest standby units; strong commercial engine heritage. 2026-11-13 check: Norwall $5,747.50 in stock (within 2% of $5,800).

standby_generators.notes: Compact QuietConnect rated 65 dB(A); full 13kW on both natural gas and propane.

standby_generators.name: Champion 14kW Standby
standby_generators.notes: Budget-friendly with a notably long 10-year limited warranty.
